summary: @onereach/channel-transformer preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it to 0o755, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line, string-array-rotation obfuscated Bun-tagged script (`// @bun @bun-cjs`, mangled identifiers such as WV8StW/hc1jfK9, >1000-entry numeric lookup table) whose behavior is not disclosed by the README (which advertises Slack/Teams channel transformation). The alien runtime is fetched specifically to execute an opaque payload unrelated to the package's stated purpose, evading Node-based static and dynamic scanners. Execution occurs automatically on `npm install`, giving the shipped payload full-host code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
